verdicts.originalText: With Moonsign Ascendant Gleam (≥2 Moonsign characters), the Cool Your Jets Ducky's water-ball tick interval drops from 1.5s to 0.7s and the AoE radius increases. The planner renders the base 1.5s tick rate; the Gleam-enhanced rate is not authored.
verdicts.proposedText: Under Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam (2 or more Moonsign characters) the water-ball tick interval drops from 1.5s to 0.7s. Shown at the base 1.5s rate; the faster rate is not modeled.
verdicts.rationale: Legitimate divergence: the summon lane shows base 1.5s ticks while in game a 2+ Moonsign team speeds them to 0.7s. Compressed to remove the banned 'the planner renders' framing and the 'not authored' phrasing (now 'not modeled'), and dropped the AoE-radius claim since the timeline never displays radius. Stays rewrite (not implementDelete) because conditionally changing a summon's tick interval is a real gap — teamFaction conditions on summon-effect triggers don't resolve at parse time, per the A1 passive curator note.

claimsLost.claim: The AoE radius also increases under Moonsign Ascendant Gleam.

demotedNotes: Caveat previously also stated the summon's AoE radius increases under Moonsign Ascendant Gleam (1 → 4); dropped from the user-facing caveat because the timeline does not display AoE radius, so it is not a divergence the user could be misled by. The radius change is already documented in the A1 passive (Modular Efficiency Protocol) curator note.
